blocks.prompt: 8 (a) [printed as 7 (a)] For the function \(f(x) = 2x\) over the interval \([0, 3]\): Find the signed area.
blocks.explanation:
Signed area sirf seedha definite integral \(\int_0^3 f(x)\,dx\) hai.
Is mein upar wala hissa plus aur neeche wala minus mein ginta hai.
Plan: power rule se integral aur limits.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = 2x\), interval \([0, 3]\).
Maloom karna: signed area.
Tareeqa: Signed area \(= \int_a^b f(x)\,dx\); koi torna ya modulus nahi chahiye.

Qadam 1: Integrate karein
\[\int_0^3 2x\,dx = \left[x^{2}\right]_0^3 = 9 - 0 = 9\]
Kyun: Power rule: \(\int 2x\,dx = 2\cdot\frac{x^{2}}{2} = x^{2}\). Upar ki limit 3 par \(9\), neeche ki limit 0 par \(0\).

Tasdeeq:
Region ek triangle hai jiska base 3 aur height \(f(3) = 6\) hai: \(\frac{1}{2}\cdot 3\cdot 6 = 9\). Geometry ne bhi wohi diya.

blocks.prompt: 8 (b) [printed as 7 (b)] For the function \(f(x) = 2x\) over the interval \([0, 3]\): Find the total (physical) area.
blocks.explanation:
Total (physical) area ka matlab hai \(\int_0^3 |f(x)|\,dx\), yani har hissa positive gina jaye.
Is ke liye pehle dekhna hai ke interval par \(f\) ka sign kahin badalta hai ya nahi.
Plan: sign check, modulus hatana, integral.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = 2x\), interval \([0, 3]\).
Maloom karna: total area \(\int_0^3 |2x|\,dx\).
Tareeqa: \(f\) ke sign se modulus hatayenge.

Qadam 1: \(f\) ka sign
\(0 \le x \le 3\) par \(2x \ge 0\), is liye \(|2x| = 2x\).
Kyun: \(2x\) ka akela root \(x = 0\) interval ka bayan kinara hai, andar kahin sign nahi badalta.
Dhyan dein: Agar interval mein koi negative \(x\) hota (maslan \([-1, 3]\)) to torna parta.

Qadam 2: Integrate karein
\[\int_0^3 |2x|\,dx = \int_0^3 2x\,dx = 9\]
Kyun: Modulus hatne ke baad yeh bilkul part (a) wala integral hai.

blocks.prompt: 8 (c) [printed as 7 (c)] For the function \(f(x) = 2x\) over the interval \([0, 3]\): Explain why they are equal in this case.
blocks.explanation:
Signed area aur total area mein farq sirf tab aata hai jab graph ka kuch hissa axis ke neeche ho, kyunke wohi hissa signed area mein minus ho jata hai.
Is liye wazahat \([0, 3]\) par \(f\) ke sign se karni hai.
Plan: general rule batana, phir is function par lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya: signed area \(= 9\), total area \(= 9\).
Maloom karna / wazahat: yahan dono barabar kyun hain.
Tareeqa: \(\int f\,dx\) aur \(\int |f|\,dx\) ka muqabla.

Qadam 1: Kab barabar hote hain?
\[\int_a^b |f(x)|\,dx = \int_a^b f(x)\,dx \text{ when } f(x) \ge 0\]
Kyun: Agar \(f\) kahin bhi negative na ho to har jagah \(|f(x)| = f(x)\) hai, is liye dono integrals asal mein ek hi integral hain.

Qadam 2: \(f(x) = 2x\) par lagayein
\([0, 3]\) par \(f(x) = 2x \ge 0\): poora region \(x\)-axis ke upar hai (figure dekhiye), is liye signed area mein koi hissa minus nahi gina gaya.
Kyun: Sirf axis ke neeche wale hisse signed area ko total area se chhota karte hain; yahan aisa koi hissa hai hi nahi. Isi liye dono jawab ek jaise aaye.
Dhyan dein: Yeh barabari har function ke liye nahi hoti; Question 2 mein dono alag alag aaye the kyunke wahan curve neeche bhi tha.
blocks.final_answer: Function \([0, 3]\) par non-negative hai, is liye koi negative hissa nahi aur signed area total area ke barabar hai (dono 9).
